topic: Force as a Vector and Free-Body Diagrams
key_concepts: Physical quantities are classified as scalar or vector
Vector quantities have both magnitude and direction
Arrowhead points in the direction of the force
Free-body diagrams represent forces acting on an object
Free-body diagrams help analyze effects of forces on motion
A vector can be resolved into horizontal and vertical components
Vector components are projections onto the x- and y-axes
Balanced forces can be identified in stationary or constant-velocity situations
